scope: Ground-contact visual response and resident-route verification. No authored terrain, actor AI, combat, dialogue, saves or progression is changed.

dust.manufactured_surfaces: Iron and timber retain the existing at-most-two tiny grains; no soil cloud.
dust.placement: Snapshots the actual physics contact and floor normal; ray plus full-envelope shape queries shrink/omit effects beside walls or beneath low ledges. Dynamic actors are ignored, saturated shape results fail conservatively.
notes: The same effect coordinator already used by WorldAmbience drives both grains and puffs.
No decorative collider, floor mutation or source-image pixel edits are introduced.
Native review reduced opacity from the initial version and verified small effects remain below the body.

resident_routes.notes: Read-only sampling of authored linear route legs plus existing movement, conversation, painted-body and walk-cycle regressions. No NPC fix is claimed because this audit did not find a failing route.

fixtures: 24 registered crop bounds, cached frame identity, source alpha and 512px mipmapped memory budget
Both facing directions and sloped supporting planes; dust quads remain above the floor tangent
Walls, zero clearance, intervening actors and an overhanging ledge above the ankle ray
Normal/low pool changes, large delta expiration, room/warp clear, manufactured surfaces
Actual player steps, idle, jump landing, slope contacts, passive transport, warp/death/flight/noclip
verification.terrain_regression: 24 actual-controller bidirectional standing/crouching walks across six physical profiles, with dash/jump/loot checks.

notes: Actual player controller and static floor collision remain enabled; scenery and encounters are otherwise frozen for preview framing.
Each contact reports the correct regional material. Sunken Shaft step normal is (0.302854, -0.953037), not a flat-floor assumption.
All 16 final frames inspected; landings are shown at effect age 0.2 seconds.

editor_import.initial_issue_fixed: Invalid Rect2 * float expression replaced by independently scaled position and size before passing tests.

limitations: Focused test selection, not full-suite certification, full normal-health campaign or physical-phone/FPS benchmark.
The resident route audit samples authored paths, not a continuous multi-hour NPC simulation; no new AI or unique resident bodies were added.
Native rendering retains sandbox shader-cache write messages; editor import cannot save global settings outside workspace; host root-certificate warning remains.
The discarded first moss sheet remains recoverable as a local ignored temporary asset and the original ImageGen output; it is not referenced by the game.
Final test logs are local ignored artifacts; sources, tests, reports and screenshots are versioned.
